notes: LoomCollection is the locked ERC-721 implementation for collections created through LoomFactory. Its immutable PLATFORM and RESERVE recipients, and LoomFactory's immutable PLATFORM recipient and creation pauser, all resolve to the launch owner through $owner. LoomFactory creates and initializes collection clones atomically after launch; the caller of createCollection owns the new collection. Launch deployment requires no initialization calls. The pool pairs LOOM with native ETH at 1.25%; the deployment service derives its opening price from the launch policy.
